# Overview

This R Markdown document contains the analytical compound-level workflow used
to evaluate brewing-season and fermentation-stage patterns in flavor data for BZ and EZ samples.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r initialize}
rm(list = ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

############################
```

## 0. Parameters
```{r s0-parameters}
############################

## ---------- Input and output ----------
FLAVOR_FILE <- "BZ_EZ_flavor.csv"
META_FILE   <- "sample_metadata.csv"
OUTDIR      <- "Flavor_compound_Season_Stage_results"

## ---------- Metadata column names ----------
META_SAMPLE_COL <- "SampleID"
META_STAGE_COL  <- "SampleType"
META_SEASON_COL <- "Season"
META_PARK_COL   <- "Park"
META_CYCLE_COL  <- "BrewingCycle"

## ---------- Flavor table ----------
## Rows = compounds; sample IDs = columns; one fixed unique compound-ID column.
FLAVOR_COMPOUND_COL <- "CompoundID"

## ---------- Formal study design ----------
TARGET_STAGES <- c("BZ", "EZ")
CORE_CYCLES   <- c("Cycle1", "Cycle2")
SEASON_LEVELS <- c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
PARK_LEVELS   <- c("70", "30", "5")
EXPECTED_N_PER_STAGE <- 72L

## ---------- Data processing ----------
## Blank/NA values represent non-detects and are converted to zero when enabled.
NONDETECT_AS_ZERO <- TRUE

## ---------- Pseudocount selection ----------
## "auto" is recommended: the script first evaluates the scale of observed positive values.
## Options: "auto" or "manual".
PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE <- "auto"

## If PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE = "manual", use the value specified below.
MANUAL_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 1

LOD_VALUE <- NA_real_

##   c <= 10% × Q5_positive
##   c <=  1% × median_positive
AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05   <- 0.10
AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN <- 0.01

PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN <- 0.01
PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05    <- 0.10

## Compare classification stability across multiple reasonable pseudocount values.
RUN_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY <- TRUE

PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY_Q05_MULTIPLIERS <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50)
PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY_MEDIAN_MULTIPLIERS <- c(0.005, 0.01)

MIN_DETECTION_FRACTION_ANY_STAGE_SEASON <- 0.20

## ---------- Significance thresholds ----------
ALPHA_FDR <- 0.05

## ---------- Kruskal-Wallis sensitivity / QC ----------
## KW is used only as a one-factor sensitivity/QC analysis, not as the formal multivariable model.
RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY <- TRUE
KW_ADJUST_METHOD <- "BH"

MIN_ABS_DELTA_LOG2_EACH_SEASON_FOR_STABLE <- 0

STABLE_REQUIRE_EACH_SEASON_FDR <- FALSE

## ---------- limma settings ----------
LIMMA_TREND <- TRUE

## ---------- Output controls: streamlined by default ----------
## pseudocount sensitivity summary, README, sessionInfo.
SAVE_DESCRIPTIVE_SUMMARY <- TRUE
SAVE_DETAILED_QC <- FALSE
SAVE_LOG2_MATRIX <- FALSE
SAVE_PAIRWISE_SEASON_TESTS <- FALSE
SAVE_KW_DETAIL_TABLES <- FALSE
SAVE_DETAILED_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY <- FALSE

DETAIL_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "Optional_details")

############################
```

## 2. Utility functions

Define contrast, joint-test, descriptive-summary, fold-change, Kruskal–Wallis, and comparison helper functions.

```{r s2-utility-functions}
############################

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )
}

## ---------- Single-contrast test ----------
run_single_contrast <- function(base_fit, contrast_vector, contrast_name) {

  cm <- matrix(
    contrast_vector,
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(names(contrast_vector), contrast_name)
  )

  fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(base_fit, cm)
  fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2, trend = LIMMA_TREND)

  tt <- limma::topTable(
    fit2,
    coef = 1,
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH",
    sort.by = "none",
    confint = TRUE
  )

  ci_low_candidates  <- c("CI.L", "CI.025")
  ci_high_candidates <- c("CI.R", "CI.975")

  ci_low_col <- ci_low_candidates[
    ci_low_candidates %in% colnames(tt)
  ][1]

  ci_high_col <- ci_high_candidates[
    ci_high_candidates %in% colnames(tt)
  ][1]

  if (is.na(ci_low_col) || is.na(ci_high_col)) {
    stop(
      "No recognized confidence-interval columns were found in topTable(confint=TRUE).\n",
      "Current column names: ", paste(colnames(tt), collapse = ", "), "\n",
      "Expected CI columns: CI.L/CI.R or CI.025/CI.975."
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    CompoundID = rownames(tt),
    Contrast = rep(contrast_name, nrow(tt)),
    DeltaLog2 = tt$logFC,
    CI_low = tt[[ci_low_col]],
    CI_high = tt[[ci_high_col]],
    t = tt$t,
    P = tt$P.Value,
    FDR = tt$adj.P.Val,
    B = tt$B,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

## ---------- Joint F test across multiple contrasts ----------
run_joint_test <- function(base_fit, contrast_matrix, test_name) {

  fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(base_fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2, trend = LIMMA_TREND)

  tt <- limma::topTable(
    fit2,
    coef = seq_len(ncol(contrast_matrix)),
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH",
    sort.by = "none"
  )

  if (!"F" %in% colnames(tt)) {
    stop("The joint test did not return a moderated F statistic: ", test_name)
  }

  data.frame(
    CompoundID = rownames(tt),
    Test = test_name,
    F = tt$F,
    P = tt$P.Value,
    FDR = tt$adj.P.Val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

## ---------- Construct contrast vectors ----------
contrast_vec <- function(design_names, positive = NULL, negative = NULL,
                         positive_weights = NULL, negative_weights = NULL) {

  requested <- c(positive, negative)
  missing_terms <- setdiff(requested, design_names)
  if (length(missing_terms) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The contrast contains coefficient(s) absent from the design matrix: ",
      paste(missing_terms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  v <- setNames(rep(0, length(design_names)), design_names)

  if (!is.null(positive)) {
    if (is.null(positive_weights)) {
      positive_weights <- rep(1, length(positive))
    }
    v[positive] <- v[positive] + positive_weights
  }

  if (!is.null(negative)) {
    if (is.null(negative_weights)) {
      negative_weights <- rep(1, length(negative))
    }
    v[negative] <- v[negative] - negative_weights
  }

  v
}

## ---------- Stage × Season descriptive summaries ----------
make_descriptive_summary <- function(raw_mat, log2_mat, meta) {

  out <- vector("list", ncol(raw_mat))

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(raw_mat))) {

    tmp <- data.frame(
      SampleID = rownames(raw_mat),
      Stage = meta$Stage,
      Season = meta$Season,
      Raw = raw_mat[, j],
      Log2 = log2_mat[, j],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    out[[j]] <- tmp %>%
      group_by(Stage, Season) %>%
      summarise(
        N = n(),
        N_detected = sum(Raw > 0),
        DetectionFraction = mean(Raw > 0),
        RawMean = mean(Raw),
        RawMedian = median(Raw),
        Log2Mean = mean(Log2),
        Log2Median = median(Log2),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat)[j],
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}

## ---------- Seasonal extrema and range within each Stage ----------
make_season_context <- function(desc_tbl, target_stage) {

  desc_tbl %>%
    filter(Stage == target_stage) %>%
    group_by(CompoundID) %>%
    summarise(
      HighestSeason = as.character(Season[which.max(Log2Mean)]),
      LowestSeason = as.character(Season[which.min(Log2Mean)]),
      SeasonRange_Log2Mean = max(Log2Mean) - min(Log2Mean),
      MaxDetectionFraction = max(DetectionFraction),
      MinDetectionFraction = min(DetectionFraction),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

## ---------- Build classification labels ----------
combine_flags <- function(a, b, c, d) {
  labs <- c()
  if (isTRUE(a)) labs <- c(labs, "A_StableFermentation")
  if (isTRUE(b)) labs <- c(labs, "B_SeasonModulated")
  if (isTRUE(c)) labs <- c(labs, "C_InitialSeasonMarker")
  if (isTRUE(d)) labs <- c(labs, "D_TerminalSeasonMarker")
  if (length(labs) == 0) "None" else paste(labs, collapse = ";")
}

## ---------- Raw-scale fold change without pseudocount ----------
safe_raw_fc <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(numerator))
  ok <- is.finite(numerator) & is.finite(denominator)
  out[ok & denominator > 0] <- numerator[ok & denominator > 0] / denominator[ok & denominator > 0]
  out[ok & denominator == 0 & numerator > 0] <- Inf
  out[ok & denominator == 0 & numerator == 0] <- NA_real_
  out
}

## ---------- Kruskal-Wallis Season test within each Stage ----------
run_kw_season_sensitivity <- function(raw_mat, meta, target_stage) {

  idx <- as.character(meta$Stage) == target_stage
  if (sum(idx) == 0) stop("KW: no samples were found for Stage = ", target_stage, ".")

  season <- droplevels(meta$Season[idx])
  if (nlevels(season) < 2) stop("KW: fewer than two Season levels are available for ", target_stage, ".")

  xmat <- raw_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]

  out <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(xmat)), function(j) {
    x <- xmat[, j]

    if (length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) <= 1) {
      H <- 0
      df <- nlevels(season) - 1
      p <- 1
    } else {
      kt <- tryCatch(
        stats::kruskal.test(x ~ season),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(kt)) {
        H <- NA_real_
        df <- NA_real_
        p <- NA_real_
      } else {
        H <- unname(kt$statistic)
        df <- unname(kt$parameter)
        p <- kt$p.value
      }
    }

    data.frame(
      CompoundID = colnames(xmat)[j],
      Stage = target_stage,
      KW_H = H,
      KW_df = df,
      KW_P = p,
      N = length(x),
      N_detected = sum(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_SeasonsWithDetection = length(unique(as.character(season[x > 0]))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  out$KW_FDR <- p.adjust(out$KW_P, method = KW_ADJUST_METHOD)
  out$KW_P_lt_0_05 <- !is.na(out$KW_P) & out$KW_P < 0.05
  out$KW_FDR_lt_alpha <- !is.na(out$KW_FDR) & out$KW_FDR < ALPHA_FDR

  out
}

## ---------- Four-way comparison of significance calls ----------
compare_significance_calls <- function(test1_sig, test2_sig,
                                       test1_name = "KW",
                                       test2_name = "AdjustedModel") {
  ifelse(
    test1_sig & test2_sig,
    "Both_significant",
    ifelse(
      !test1_sig & test2_sig,
      paste0(test2_name, "_only"),
      ifelse(
        test1_sig & !test2_sig,
        paste0(test1_name, "_only"),
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )
}
```


## 4. Metadata import and design QC
```{r s4-metadata-import-and-design-qc}
############################

meta_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  META_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)

required_meta_cols <- c(
  META_SAMPLE_COL,
  META_STAGE_COL,
  META_SEASON_COL,
  META_PARK_COL,
  META_CYCLE_COL
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, colnames(meta_raw))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Metadata is missing required column(s): ", paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

meta <- data.frame(
  SampleID = trimws(as.character(meta_raw[[META_SAMPLE_COL]])),
  Stage = toupper(trimws(as.character(meta_raw[[META_STAGE_COL]]))),
  Season = trimws(as.character(meta_raw[[META_SEASON_COL]])),
  Park = trimws(as.character(meta_raw[[META_PARK_COL]])),
  BrewingCycle = trimws(as.character(meta_raw[[META_CYCLE_COL]])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta <- meta %>%
  filter(
    Stage %in% TARGET_STAGES,
    BrewingCycle %in% CORE_CYCLES
  )

if (nrow(meta) == 0) stop("No samples remain after restricting the analysis to BZ/EZ and Cycle1/Cycle2.")

if (anyNA(meta)) {
  write.csv(
    meta[!complete.cases(meta), , drop = FALSE],
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_metadata_missing_core_fields.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("Missing values were found in required metadata fields.")
}

if (any(meta$SampleID == "")) stop("Blank SampleID values were found in metadata.")

if (anyDuplicated(meta$SampleID)) {
  dup <- unique(meta$SampleID[duplicated(meta$SampleID)])
  write.csv(
    data.frame(SampleID = dup),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_duplicate_metadata_SampleID.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("Duplicated SampleID values were found in metadata.")
}

bad_season <- setdiff(unique(meta$Season), SEASON_LEVELS)
bad_park <- setdiff(unique(meta$Park), PARK_LEVELS)
bad_cycle <- setdiff(unique(meta$BrewingCycle), CORE_CYCLES)
bad_stage <- setdiff(unique(meta$Stage), TARGET_STAGES)

if (length(bad_season) > 0) stop("Undefined Season value(s): ", paste(bad_season, collapse = ", "))
if (length(bad_park) > 0) stop("Undefined Park value(s): ", paste(bad_park, collapse = ", "))
if (length(bad_cycle) > 0) stop("Undefined BrewingCycle value(s): ", paste(bad_cycle, collapse = ", "))
if (length(bad_stage) > 0) stop("Undefined Stage value(s): ", paste(bad_stage, collapse = ", "))

stage_n <- table(meta$Stage)
for (st in TARGET_STAGES) {
  n_st <- if (st %in% names(stage_n)) as.integer(stage_n[[st]]) else 0L
  if (n_st != EXPECTED_N_PER_STAGE) {
    stop(st, " sample count = ", n_st, "; expected = ", EXPECTED_N_PER_STAGE, ".")
  }
}

meta$Stage <- factor(meta$Stage, levels = TARGET_STAGES)
meta$Season <- factor(meta$Season, levels = SEASON_LEVELS)
meta$Park <- factor(meta$Park, levels = PARK_LEVELS)
meta$BrewingCycle <- factor(meta$BrewingCycle, levels = CORE_CYCLES)

## Check the Stage × Season × Park × BrewingCycle design.
cell_count <- meta %>%
  count(Stage, Season, Park, BrewingCycle, name = "N", .drop = FALSE)

write.csv(
  cell_count,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "00_design_cell_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (any(cell_count$N == 0L) || length(unique(cell_count$N)) > 1L) {
  warning("The factorial design has empty or unequal cells; inspect 00_design_cell_counts.csv. Model estimability is checked below.")
}

message(
  "Metadata QC passed: total samples = ", nrow(meta),
  ";BZ=", sum(meta$Stage == "BZ"),
  ";EZ=", sum(meta$Stage == "EZ")
)

############################
```

## 5. Import flavor matrix
```{r s5-import-flavor-matrix}
############################

flavor_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  FLAVOR_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)

if (!FLAVOR_COMPOUND_COL %in% colnames(flavor_raw)) {
  stop("The flavor table is missing the required ID column: ", FLAVOR_COMPOUND_COL)
}

colnames(flavor_raw) <- trimws(colnames(flavor_raw))
if (anyDuplicated(colnames(flavor_raw))) {
  stop("The flavor table contains duplicated column names after trimming whitespace.")
}
compound_id <- trimws(as.character(flavor_raw[[FLAVOR_COMPOUND_COL]]))

bad_blank <- which(is.na(compound_id) | compound_id == "")
if (length(bad_blank) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(Row = bad_blank, CompoundID = compound_id[bad_blank]),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_blank_compound_ID.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("Blank or NA CompoundID values were found.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(compound_id)) {
  dup_values <- unique(compound_id[duplicated(compound_id)])
  dup_rows <- which(compound_id %in% dup_values)
  write.csv(
    data.frame(Row = dup_rows, CompoundID = compound_id[dup_rows]),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_duplicate_compound_ID_rows.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("Duplicated CompoundID values were found.")
}

meta_ids <- as.character(meta$SampleID)
missing_in_flavor <- setdiff(meta_ids, colnames(flavor_raw))
if (length(missing_in_flavor) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(SampleID = missing_in_flavor),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_metadata_samples_missing_from_flavor.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop(length(missing_in_flavor), " analysis sample(s) are missing from the flavor table.")
}

flavor_numeric <- flavor_raw[, meta_ids, drop = FALSE]

for (cc in meta_ids) {
  old <- flavor_numeric[[cc]]
  new <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(old))

  newly_na <- is.na(new) &
    !is.na(old) &
    trimws(as.character(old)) != ""

  if (any(newly_na)) {
    bad_rows <- which(newly_na)
    write.csv(
      data.frame(
        Row = bad_rows,
        CompoundID = compound_id[bad_rows],
        SampleID = cc,
        OriginalValue = as.character(old[bad_rows])
      ),
      file.path(
        OUTDIR,
        paste0("ERROR_non_numeric_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", cc), ".csv")
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    stop("Non-numeric content was found in sample column ", cc, ".")
  }

  flavor_numeric[[cc]] <- new
}

## Transpose to sample × compound.
raw_mat <- t(as.matrix(flavor_numeric))
rownames(raw_mat) <- meta_ids
colnames(raw_mat) <- compound_id
storage.mode(raw_mat) <- "numeric"

if (!identical(rownames(raw_mat), meta_ids)) {
  stop("Sample order in the flavor matrix does not match metadata.")
}

############################
```

## 6. Non-detect handling and numeric QC
```{r s6-non-detect-handling-and-numeric-qc}
############################

n_na_before <- sum(is.na(raw_mat))

if (n_na_before > 0) {

  idx_na <- which(is.na(raw_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)

  if (SAVE_DETAILED_QC) {
    write.csv(
        data.frame(
          SampleID = rownames(raw_mat)[idx_na[, 1]],
          CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat)[idx_na[, 2]]
        ),
        file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "01_non_detect_cells_converted_to_zero.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
  }

  if (NONDETECT_AS_ZERO) {
    raw_mat[is.na(raw_mat)] <- 0
  } else {
    stop("NA values are present while NONDETECT_AS_ZERO = FALSE.")
  }
}

if (anyNA(raw_mat)) stop("NA values remain after non-detect handling.")
if (any(!is.finite(raw_mat))) stop("The flavor matrix contains NaN/Inf/-Inf values.")

if (any(raw_mat < 0)) {
  idx_neg <- which(raw_mat < 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      SampleID = rownames(raw_mat)[idx_neg[, 1]],
      CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat)[idx_neg[, 2]],
      Value = raw_mat[idx_neg]
    ),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_negative_flavor_values.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop("Negative values were found in the flavor data.")
}

############################
```

## 7. Detection-frequency filtering
```{r s7-detection-frequency-filtering}
############################

stage_season_group <- interaction(
  meta$Stage,
  meta$Season,
  drop = TRUE,
  sep = "_"
)

all_group_levels <- levels(stage_season_group)

detection_by_group <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(all_group_levels, function(g) {
    idx <- stage_season_group == g
    data.frame(
      CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat),
      StageSeason = g,
      N = sum(idx),
      N_detected = colSums(raw_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE] > 0),
      DetectionFraction = colMeans(raw_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE] > 0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

if (SAVE_DETAILED_QC) {
  write.csv(
    detection_by_group,
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "02_detection_fraction_by_StageSeason.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

max_detection <- detection_by_group %>%
  group_by(CompoundID) %>%
  summarise(
    MaxDetectionFractionAnyStageSeason = max(DetectionFraction),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Number of true detections across all analysis samples.
max_detection$N_detected_all <- colSums(raw_mat > 0)[
  match(max_detection$CompoundID, colnames(raw_mat))
]

keep_tbl <- max_detection %>%
  mutate(
    Keep = N_detected_all > 0 &
      MaxDetectionFractionAnyStageSeason >=
      MIN_DETECTION_FRACTION_ANY_STAGE_SEASON
  )

write.csv(
  keep_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "01_compound_detection_QC.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

removed_tbl <- keep_tbl %>% filter(!Keep)
if (SAVE_DETAILED_QC) {
  write.csv(
    removed_tbl,
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "03_compounds_removed_by_detection_filter.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

keep_ids <- keep_tbl$CompoundID[keep_tbl$Keep]
raw_mat <- raw_mat[, keep_ids, drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(raw_mat) < 2) stop("Fewer than two compounds remain after filtering.")

message(
  "Detection-frequency filter: retained ", ncol(raw_mat),
  " compounds; removed ", nrow(removed_tbl), " compounds."
)

############################
```

## 8. Pseudocount scale QC and automatic selection
```{r s8-pseudocount-scale-qc-and-automatic-selecti}
############################

positive_values <- raw_mat[
  is.finite(raw_mat) & raw_mat > 0
]

if (length(positive_values) == 0) {
  stop("No positive values remain after filtering; the pseudocount cannot be determined.")
}

pos_q <- stats::quantile(
  positive_values,
  probs = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1),
  names = FALSE,
  type = 7
)

positive_distribution_qc <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Minimum_positive", "Q01_positive", "Q05_positive",
    "Q10_positive", "Q25_positive", "Median_positive",
    "Q75_positive", "Maximum_positive", "Mean_positive",
    "Zero_fraction_all_cells"
  ),
  Value = c(
    pos_q[1], pos_q[2], pos_q[3], pos_q[4], pos_q[5],
    pos_q[6], pos_q[7], pos_q[8], mean(positive_values),
    mean(raw_mat == 0)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  positive_distribution_qc,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "02_pseudocount_global_QC.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

q01_positive <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(positive_values, 0.01, names = FALSE))
q05_positive <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(positive_values, 0.05, names = FALSE))
q10_positive <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(positive_values, 0.10, names = FALSE))
median_positive <- median(positive_values)

plus1_ratio_median <- 1 / median_positive
plus1_ratio_q05 <- 1 / q05_positive

plus1_negligible <-
  is.finite(plus1_ratio_median) &&
  is.finite(plus1_ratio_q05) &&
  plus1_ratio_median <= PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN &&
  plus1_ratio_q05 <= PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05

## Select the primary pseudocount:
## 1) manual -> user-specified value
## 2) auto + a valid common LOD -> LOD/2
## 3) auto + +1 is sufficiently small relative to the data scale -> 1
## 4) auto + +1 is too large -> min(10% × Q5_positive, 1% × median_positive)
if (!PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE %in% c("auto", "manual")) {
  stop("PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE must be either auto or manual.")
}

if (PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE == "manual") {

  LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT <- MANUAL_PSEUDOCOUNT
  PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE <- "Manual user-specified pseudocount"

} else if (is.finite(LOD_VALUE) && LOD_VALUE > 0) {

  LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT <- LOD_VALUE / 2
  PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE <- "LOD/2 (preferred because a valid common LOD was supplied)"

} else if (plus1_negligible) {

  LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 1
  PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE <- paste0(
    "+1 retained because it is small relative to the observed scale: ",
    "1/median_positive=", sprintf("%.4g", plus1_ratio_median),
    "; 1/Q05_positive=", sprintf("%.4g", plus1_ratio_q05)
  )

} else {

  c_from_q05 <- AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05 * q05_positive
  c_from_median <- AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN * median_positive

  LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT <- min(c_from_q05, c_from_median)

  limiting_rule <- if (c_from_q05 <= c_from_median) {
    "Q5_positive constraint"
  } else {
    "median_positive constraint"
  }

  PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE <- paste0(
    "+1 judged too large for the observed lower abundance range; no common LOD supplied. ",
    "Selected min(",
    AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05 * 100, "% × Q5_positive = ",
    signif(c_from_q05, 6), ", ",
    AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN * 100, "% × median_positive = ",
    signif(c_from_median, 6), ") = ",
    signif(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT, 6), ". Limiting rule: ", limiting_rule, ". ",
    "This is a conservative data-driven pseudocount intended to remain small relative to real positive values; ",
    "it is not interpreted as an analytical detection limit."
  )
}

if (!is.numeric(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT) ||
    length(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT) != 1 ||
    !is.finite(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT) ||
    LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT <= 0) {
  stop("The selected LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT is not a valid positive number.")
}

## Compound-level QC of the selected global pseudocount relative to each compound scale.
compound_pseudocount_qc <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(raw_mat)), function(j) {

  z <- raw_mat[, j]
  zp <- z[is.finite(z) & z > 0]

  if (length(zp) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat)[j], N_positive = 0,
      Min_positive = NA_real_, Q05_positive = NA_real_,
      Median_positive = NA_real_,
      SelectedC_over_Q05 = NA_real_,
      SelectedC_over_Median = NA_real_,
      Plus1_over_Q05 = NA_real_, Plus1_over_Median = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  q05j <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(zp, 0.05, names = FALSE))
  medj <- median(zp)

  data.frame(
    CompoundID = colnames(raw_mat)[j],
    N_positive = length(zp),
    Min_positive = min(zp),
    Q05_positive = q05j,
    Median_positive = medj,
    SelectedC_over_Q05 = LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT / q05j,
    SelectedC_over_Median = LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT / medj,
    Plus1_over_Q05 = 1 / q05j,
    Plus1_over_Median = 1 / medj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

if (SAVE_DETAILED_QC) {
  write.csv(
    compound_pseudocount_qc,
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "04_pseudocount_QC_by_compound.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

plus1_assessment <- if (plus1_negligible) {
  "+1 is small relative to both the median and lower-end positive values under the preset criteria."
} else {
  paste0(
    "+1 is NOT recommended as the default under the preset criteria: ",
    "1/median_positive=", sprintf("%.4g", plus1_ratio_median),
    " (criterion <= ", PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN, "); ",
    "1/Q05_positive=", sprintf("%.4g", plus1_ratio_q05),
    " (criterion <= ", PLUS1_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05, ")."
  )
}

pseudocount_notes <- c(
  "Pseudocount QC and selection",
  "",
  paste0("Positive minimum = ", signif(min(positive_values), 6)),
  paste0("Positive Q01 = ", signif(q01_positive, 6)),
  paste0("Positive Q05 = ", signif(q05_positive, 6)),
  paste0("Positive Q10 = ", signif(q10_positive, 6)),
  paste0("Positive median = ", signif(median_positive, 6)),
  paste0("Zero/non-detect fraction = ", signif(mean(raw_mat == 0), 6)),
  "",
  plus1_assessment,
  "",
  paste0("Selected pseudocount = ", signif(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT, 8)),
  paste0("Selection rule: ", PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE),
  "",
  "Interpretation hierarchy:",
  "1. If a valid common analytical LOD exists in the same units, LOD/2 is preferred.",
  "2. Without LOD, +1 is retained only when it is negligible relative to the observed positive-value scale.",
  paste0(
    "3. If +1 is too large and no LOD is available, the default data-driven pseudocount is min(",
    AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_Q05 * 100, "% × Q5_positive, ",
    AUTO_PSEUDOCOUNT_MAX_RATIO_TO_MEDIAN * 100, "% × median_positive)."
  ),
  "4. The selected value is deliberately constrained to remain small relative to both the low-end positive distribution and the overall positive-value scale.",
  "5. This data-driven choice is a pragmatic approximation, not a physical detection limit; therefore pseudocount sensitivity analysis is retained.",
  "6. Raw-scale fold changes should still be calculated from original values; the pseudocount is used for log-scale modelling, not to redefine biological fold change."
)

writeLines(
  pseudocount_notes,
  con = file.path(OUTDIR, "03_pseudocount_recommendation.txt")
)

message("Pseudocount QC:")
message("  positive Q05 = ", signif(q05_positive, 6))
message("  positive median = ", signif(median_positive, 6))
message("  +1 assessment = ", plus1_assessment)
message("  selected pseudocount = ", signif(LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT, 8))
message("  rule = ", PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE)

############################
```

## 11. Stage × Season + Park + BrewingCycle model
```{r s11-stage-season-park-brewingcycle-model}
############################

GROUP_LEVELS <- c(
  paste("BZ", SEASON_LEVELS, sep = "_"),
  paste("EZ", SEASON_LEVELS, sep = "_")
)

meta$StageSeason <- factor(
  paste(meta$Stage, meta$Season, sep = "_"),
  levels = GROUP_LEVELS
)

if (anyNA(meta$StageSeason)) stop("StageSeason construction failed.")

## Eight Stage × Season cell means + Park + BrewingCycle.
## Park and BrewingCycle are included as background covariates.
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + StageSeason + Park + BrewingCycle,
  data = meta
)

colnames(design) <- sub("^StageSeason", "", colnames(design))

design_rank <- qr(design)$rank
if (design_rank < ncol(design)) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(DesignColumn = colnames(design)),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_design_matrix_columns.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  stop(
    "The linear-model design matrix is rank deficient: rank = ", design_rank,
    ",columns=", ncol(design),
    ". Check Stage/Season/Park/BrewingCycle for complete collinearity."
  )
}

if (SAVE_DETAILED_QC) {
  write.csv(
    data.frame(SampleID = meta$SampleID, design, check.names = FALSE),
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "10_model_design_matrix.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

## limma input: rows = compounds, columns = samples.
Y <- t(log2_mat)

if (!identical(colnames(Y), as.character(meta$SampleID))) {
  stop("Sample order in the limma input matrix does not match metadata.")
}

base_fit <- limma::lmFit(Y, design)

design_names <- colnames(design)
```

## 12. Season-associated compounds within BZ and EZ
```{r s12-season-associated-compounds-within-bz-and}
############################

## Joint F test for overall differences among the four seasons.
## Three independent contrasts use Spring as the reference; the joint test is reference-invariant.

make_season_joint_matrix <- function(stage_name) {

  ref <- paste(stage_name, "Spring", sep = "_")
  others <- c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")

  cm <- sapply(others, function(ss) {
    contrast_vec(
      design_names,
      positive = paste(stage_name, ss, sep = "_"),
      negative = ref
    )
  })

  if (is.null(dim(cm))) cm <- matrix(cm, ncol = 1)
  rownames(cm) <- design_names
  colnames(cm) <- paste0(stage_name, "_", others, "_vs_Spring")
  cm
}

bz_season_joint <- run_joint_test(
  base_fit,
  make_season_joint_matrix("BZ"),
  "BZ_Season_omnibus"
) %>%
  rename(
    BZ_Season_F = F,
    BZ_Season_P = P,
    BZ_Season_FDR = FDR
  ) %>%
  select(-Test) %>%
  left_join(bz_context, by = "CompoundID")

ez_season_joint <- run_joint_test(
  base_fit,
  make_season_joint_matrix("EZ"),
  "EZ_Season_omnibus"
) %>%
  rename(
    EZ_Season_F = F,
    EZ_Season_P = P,
    EZ_Season_FDR = FDR
  ) %>%
  select(-Test) %>%
  left_join(ez_context, by = "CompoundID")


## ---------- Optional pairwise comparisons among seasons ----------
if (SAVE_PAIRWISE_SEASON_TESTS) {

  season_pairs <- combn(SEASON_LEVELS, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  run_stage_season_pairwise <- function(stage_name) {

    out <- lapply(season_pairs, function(pr) {
      s1 <- pr[1]
      s2 <- pr[2]

      cv <- contrast_vec(
        design_names,
        positive = paste(stage_name, s2, sep = "_"),
        negative = paste(stage_name, s1, sep = "_")
      )

      run_single_contrast(
        base_fit,
        cv,
        paste0(stage_name, "_", s2, "_vs_", s1)
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          Stage = stage_name,
          Season1 = s1,
          Season2 = s2,
          Direction = case_when(
            DeltaLog2 > 0 ~ paste0(s2, " > ", s1),
            DeltaLog2 < 0 ~ paste0(s2, " < ", s1),
            TRUE ~ "No_direction"
          ),
          .before = 2
        )
    })

    bind_rows(out)
  }

  bz_season_pairwise <- run_stage_season_pairwise("BZ")
  ez_season_pairwise <- run_stage_season_pairwise("EZ")

  write.csv(
    bz_season_pairwise %>% arrange(Contrast, FDR, desc(abs(DeltaLog2))),
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "11_BZ_Season_pairwise_compound_tests.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    ez_season_pairwise %>% arrange(Contrast, FDR, desc(abs(DeltaLog2))),
    file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "12_EZ_Season_pairwise_compound_tests.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

############################
```

## 13. Overall BZ-to-EZ fermentation response
```{r s13-overall-bz-to-ez-fermentation-response}
############################

bz_cells <- paste("BZ", SEASON_LEVELS, sep = "_")
ez_cells <- paste("EZ", SEASON_LEVELS, sep = "_")

cv_overall_stage <- contrast_vec(
  design_names,
  positive = ez_cells,
  negative = bz_cells,
  positive_weights = rep(1 / 4, 4),
  negative_weights = rep(1 / 4, 4)
)

overall_stage <- run_single_contrast(
  base_fit,
  cv_overall_stage,
  "Overall_EZ_minus_BZ_average_across_4_seasons"
) %>%
  rename(
    Overall_DeltaLog2_EZminusBZ = DeltaLog2,
    Overall_CI_low = CI_low,
    Overall_CI_high = CI_high,
    Overall_t = t,
    Overall_P = P,
    Overall_FDR = FDR,
    Overall_B = B
  ) %>%
  select(-Contrast) %>%
  mutate(
    OverallResponse = case_when(
      Overall_FDR < ALPHA_FDR & Overall_DeltaLog2_EZminusBZ > 0 ~ "EZ_enriched",
      Overall_FDR < ALPHA_FDR & Overall_DeltaLog2_EZminusBZ < 0 ~ "EZ_depleted",
      TRUE ~ "Not_significant"
    )
  )


############################
```

## 14. Season-specific BZ-to-EZ responses
```{r s14-season-specific-bz-to-ez-responses}

stage_season_response_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(SEASON_LEVELS, function(ss) {

    cv <- contrast_vec(
      design_names,
      positive = paste("EZ", ss, sep = "_"),
      negative = paste("BZ", ss, sep = "_")
    )

    run_single_contrast(
      base_fit,
      cv,
      paste0(ss, "_EZ_minus_BZ")
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Season = ss,
        Direction = case_when(
          DeltaLog2 > 0 ~ "EZ_enriched",
          DeltaLog2 < 0 ~ "EZ_depleted",
          TRUE ~ "No_direction"
        ),
        .before = 2
      )
  })
)


## Convert to wide format for classification.
stage_season_response_wide <- stage_season_response_long %>%
  select(CompoundID, Season, DeltaLog2, P, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Season,
    values_from = c(DeltaLog2, P, FDR),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Season}"
```

## 15. Stage × Season interaction
```{r s15-stage-season-interaction}
############################

## Test whether the EZ-BZ response differs by Season.
## Use the Spring stage effect as reference and jointly test the other three seasons.

cv_int_summer <- contrast_vec(
  design_names,
  positive = c("EZ_Summer", "BZ_Spring"),
  negative = c("BZ_Summer", "EZ_Spring")
)

cv_int_autumn <- contrast_vec(
  design_names,
  positive = c("EZ_Autumn", "BZ_Spring"),
  negative = c("BZ_Autumn", "EZ_Spring")
)

cv_int_winter <- contrast_vec(
  design_names,
  positive = c("EZ_Winter", "BZ_Spring"),
  negative = c("BZ_Winter", "EZ_Spring")
)

interaction_cm <- cbind(
  Summer_vs_Spring_stage_effect = cv_int_summer,
  Autumn_vs_Spring_stage_effect = cv_int_autumn,
  Winter_vs_Spring_stage_effect = cv_int_winter
)

stage_season_interaction <- run_joint_test(
  base_fit,
  interaction_cm,
  "Stage_x_Season_omnibus"
) %>%
  rename(
    StageSeasonInteraction_F = F,
    StageSeasonInteraction_P = P,
    StageSeasonInteraction_FDR = FDR
  ) %>%
  select(-Test)


############################
```

## 16. Master table and final classification axes
```{r s16-master-table-and-final-classification-axes}
############################

master <- overall_stage %>%
  full_join(stage_season_response_wide, by = "CompoundID") %>%
  full_join(stage_season_interaction, by = "CompoundID") %>%
  full_join(bz_season_joint, by = "CompoundID") %>%
  full_join(ez_season_joint, by = "CompoundID") %>%
  left_join(raw_overall_fc, by = "CompoundID") %>%
  left_join(raw_fc_season_wide, by = "CompoundID")

if (RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY) {
  master <- master %>%
    left_join(kw_bz, by = "CompoundID") %>%
    left_join(kw_ez, by = "CompoundID")
}

## Check required columns.
needed_delta_cols <- paste0("DeltaLog2_", SEASON_LEVELS)
needed_fdr_cols <- paste0("FDR_", SEASON_LEVELS)

if (!all(needed_delta_cols %in% colnames(master))) {
  stop("The classification table is missing season-specific Stage-effect column(s): ", paste(setdiff(needed_delta_cols, colnames(master)), collapse = ", "))
}

season_delta_mat <- as.matrix(master[, needed_delta_cols, drop = FALSE])
season_fdr_mat <- as.matrix(master[, needed_fdr_cols, drop = FALSE])

all_positive <- apply(
  season_delta_mat,
  1,
  function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z > 0)
)

all_negative <- apply(
  season_delta_mat,
  1,
  function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z < 0)
)

same_direction <- all_positive | all_negative

min_abs_delta <- apply(
  abs(season_delta_mat),
  1,
  function(z) if (all(is.finite(z))) min(z) else NA_real_
)

all_season_fdr_sig <- apply(
  season_fdr_mat,
  1,
  function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z < ALPHA_FDR)
)

stable_base <-
  !is.na(master$Overall_FDR) &
  master$Overall_FDR < ALPHA_FDR &
  same_direction &
  !is.na(min_abs_delta) &
  min_abs_delta >= MIN_ABS_DELTA_LOG2_EACH_SEASON_FOR_STABLE

if (STABLE_REQUIRE_EACH_SEASON_FDR) {
  stable_base <- stable_base & all_season_fdr_sig
}

master$A_StableFermentation <- stable_base
master$A_StableDirection <- ifelse(
  all_positive,
  "EZ_enriched_all_4_seasons",
  ifelse(all_negative, "EZ_depleted_all_4_seasons", "Not_same_direction")
)
master$A_MinAbsDeltaLog2AcrossSeasons <- min_abs_delta
master$A_All4SeasonContrastsFDRsig <- all_season_fdr_sig

master$B_SeasonModulatedFermentation <-
  !is.na(master$StageSeasonInteraction_FDR) &
  master$StageSeasonInteraction_FDR < ALPHA_FDR

master$C_InitialSeasonMarker <-
  !is.na(master$BZ_Season_FDR) &
  master$BZ_Season_FDR < ALPHA_FDR

master$D_TerminalSeasonMarker <-
  !is.na(master$EZ_Season_FDR) &
  master$EZ_Season_FDR < ALPHA_FDR

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Final fermentation-response classification (I-IV, mutually exclusive)
## ----------------------------------------------------------
master$FermentationResponseType <- case_when(
  master$A_StableFermentation & master$B_SeasonModulatedFermentation ~
    "I_Stable_direction_but_season_modulated",
  master$A_StableFermentation & !master$B_SeasonModulatedFermentation ~
    "II_Stable_season_independent",
  !master$A_StableFermentation & master$B_SeasonModulatedFermentation ~
    "III_Season_dependent_directionally_nonstable",
  TRUE ~ "IV_Other"
)

## Legacy output labels are retained for downstream compatibility.
## Type II means no detected Stage x Season interaction, not proven independence.
## Type III means B is supported but the full A criterion is not met; it does
## not necessarily mean that the four estimated stage effects change sign.

## Compare KW calls with the formal multivariable Season omnibus model.
## A-D flags are defined by the formal model; the following fields are sensitivity/QC only.
if (RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY) {

  master$BZ_Model_P_lt_0_05 <-
    !is.na(master$BZ_Season_P) & master$BZ_Season_P < 0.05
  master$EZ_Model_P_lt_0_05 <-
    !is.na(master$EZ_Season_P) & master$EZ_Season_P < 0.05

  master$BZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha <- master$C_InitialSeasonMarker
  master$EZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha <- master$D_TerminalSeasonMarker

  master$BZ_KW_vs_Model_rawP <- compare_significance_calls(
    master$BZ_KW_P_lt_0_05,
    master$BZ_Model_P_lt_0_05,
    "KW",
    "AdjustedModel"
  )

  master$EZ_KW_vs_Model_rawP <- compare_significance_calls(
    master$EZ_KW_P_lt_0_05,
    master$EZ_Model_P_lt_0_05,
    "KW",
    "AdjustedModel"
  )

  master$BZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR <- compare_significance_calls(
    master$BZ_KW_FDR_lt_alpha,
    master$BZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha,
    "KW",
    "AdjustedModel"
  )

  master$EZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR <- compare_significance_calls(
    master$EZ_KW_FDR_lt_alpha,
    master$EZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha,
    "KW",
    "AdjustedModel"
  )

  master$BZ_KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not <-
    master$BZ_KW_P_lt_0_05 & !master$BZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha
  master$EZ_KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not <-
    master$EZ_KW_P_lt_0_05 & !master$EZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha

  master$BZ_Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not <-
    master$BZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha & !master$BZ_KW_P_lt_0_05
  master$EZ_Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not <-
    master$EZ_Model_FDR_lt_alpha & !master$EZ_KW_P_lt_0_05
}

## Sort MASTER by I-IV response type and then by the primary FDR values.
master <- master %>%
  arrange(
    FermentationResponseType,
    StageSeasonInteraction_FDR,
    Overall_FDR,
    BZ_Season_FDR,
    EZ_Season_FDR
  )

write.csv(
  master,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "05_MASTER_compound_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################
```

## 18B. KW versus adjusted-model concordance
```{r s18b-kw-versus-adjusted-model-concordance}
############################

kw_model_summary <- NULL
kw_model_discordant <- NULL

if (RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY) {

  make_concordance_summary <- function(stage_name, criterion, comparison_vector) {
    lv <- c("Both_significant", "AdjustedModel_only", "KW_only", "Neither")
    tt <- table(factor(comparison_vector, levels = lv))
    data.frame(
      Stage = stage_name,
      Criterion = criterion,
      Call = lv,
      N = as.integer(tt),
      Fraction = as.integer(tt) / length(comparison_vector),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  kw_model_summary <- bind_rows(
    make_concordance_summary("BZ", "raw_P_lt_0.05", master$BZ_KW_vs_Model_rawP),
    make_concordance_summary("EZ", "raw_P_lt_0.05", master$EZ_KW_vs_Model_rawP),
    make_concordance_summary("BZ", paste0("BH_FDR_lt_", ALPHA_FDR), master$BZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR),
    make_concordance_summary("EZ", paste0("BH_FDR_lt_", ALPHA_FDR), master$EZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR)
  )

  write.csv(
    kw_model_summary,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "10_KW_vs_adjusted_model_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  make_discordant_stage <- function(stage_name) {

    if (stage_name == "BZ") {
      tmp <- master %>%
        transmute(
          Stage = "BZ", CompoundID,
          FDR_Comparison = BZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR,
          KW_P = BZ_KW_P, KW_FDR = BZ_KW_FDR,
          AdjustedModel_P = BZ_Season_P, AdjustedModel_FDR = BZ_Season_FDR,
          KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not = BZ_KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not,
          Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not = BZ_Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not,
          FermentationResponseType
        )
    } else {
      tmp <- master %>%
        transmute(
          Stage = "EZ", CompoundID,
          FDR_Comparison = EZ_KW_vs_Model_FDR,
          KW_P = EZ_KW_P, KW_FDR = EZ_KW_FDR,
          AdjustedModel_P = EZ_Season_P, AdjustedModel_FDR = EZ_Season_FDR,
          KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not = EZ_KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not,
          Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not = EZ_Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not,
          FermentationResponseType
        )
    }

    tmp %>%
      mutate(
        PrismStyleComparison = case_when(
          KW_rawP_sig_but_Model_FDR_not ~ "KW_rawP_significant_but_Model_FDR_not",
          Model_FDR_sig_but_KW_rawP_not ~ "Model_FDR_significant_but_KW_rawP_not",
          TRUE ~ "No_PrismStyle_discordance"
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(
        FDR_Comparison %in% c("KW_only", "AdjustedModel_only") |
          PrismStyleComparison != "No_PrismStyle_discordance"
      )
  }

  kw_model_discordant <- bind_rows(
    make_discordant_stage("BZ"),
    make_discordant_stage("EZ")
  ) %>%
    arrange(Stage, FDR_Comparison, AdjustedModel_FDR, KW_FDR)

  write.csv(
    kw_model_discordant,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "11_KW_adjusted_model_discordant_compounds.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

############################
```

## 19. Pseudocount sensitivity analysis
```{r s19-pseudocount-sensitivity-analysis}
############################

if (RUN_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY) {

  candidate_tbl <- data.frame(
    Rule = character(0),
    Pseudocount = numeric(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  candidate_tbl <- bind_rows(
    candidate_tbl,
    data.frame(Rule = "Fixed_plus_1", Pseudocount = 1)
  )

  for (mm in PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY_Q05_MULTIPLIERS) {
    candidate_tbl <- bind_rows(
      candidate_tbl,
      data.frame(
        Rule = paste0(mm * 100, "pct_of_Q05_positive"),
        Pseudocount = mm * q05_positive
      )
    )
  }

  for (mm in PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY_MEDIAN_MULTIPLIERS) {
    candidate_tbl <- bind_rows(
      candidate_tbl,
      data.frame(
        Rule = paste0(mm * 100, "pct_of_median_positive"),
        Pseudocount = mm * median_positive
      )
    )
  }

  candidate_tbl <- bind_rows(
    candidate_tbl,
    data.frame(Rule = "Primary_selected", Pseudocount = LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT)
  )

  if (is.finite(LOD_VALUE) && LOD_VALUE > 0) {
    candidate_tbl <- bind_rows(
      candidate_tbl,
      data.frame(Rule = "LOD_over_2", Pseudocount = LOD_VALUE / 2)
    )
  }

  candidate_tbl <- candidate_tbl %>%
    filter(is.finite(Pseudocount), Pseudocount > 0) %>%
    arrange(Pseudocount)

  candidate_tbl$Key <- signif(candidate_tbl$Pseudocount, 12)
  candidate_tbl <- candidate_tbl %>%
    arrange(desc(Rule == "Primary_selected")) %>%
    distinct(Key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-Key) %>%
    arrange(Pseudocount)

  if (SAVE_DETAILED_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY) {
    write.csv(
        candidate_tbl,
        file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "13_pseudocount_sensitivity_candidates.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
  }

  run_core_classification_for_c <- function(c_value, c_rule) {

    logm <- log2(raw_mat + c_value)
    Yc <- t(logm)
    fitc <- limma::lmFit(Yc, design)

    bzj <- run_joint_test(
      fitc, make_season_joint_matrix("BZ"), "BZ_Season_omnibus"
    ) %>%
      transmute(CompoundID, BZ_Season_FDR = FDR)

    ezj <- run_joint_test(
      fitc, make_season_joint_matrix("EZ"), "EZ_Season_omnibus"
    ) %>%
      transmute(CompoundID, EZ_Season_FDR = FDR)

    ov <- run_single_contrast(
      fitc, cv_overall_stage, "Overall_EZ_minus_BZ_average_across_4_seasons"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        CompoundID,
        Overall_DeltaLog2_EZminusBZ = DeltaLog2,
        Overall_FDR = FDR
      )

    ints <- run_joint_test(
      fitc, interaction_cm, "Stage_x_Season_omnibus"
    ) %>%
      transmute(CompoundID, StageSeasonInteraction_FDR = FDR)

    seas <- bind_rows(lapply(SEASON_LEVELS, function(ss) {
      cv <- contrast_vec(
        design_names,
        positive = paste("EZ", ss, sep = "_"),
        negative = paste("BZ", ss, sep = "_")
      )
      run_single_contrast(fitc, cv, paste0(ss, "_EZ_minus_BZ")) %>%
        transmute(CompoundID, Season = ss, DeltaLog2, FDR)
    }))

    seas_w <- seas %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = Season,
        values_from = c(DeltaLog2, FDR),
        names_glue = "{.value}_{Season}"
      )

    tmp <- ov %>%
      full_join(seas_w, by = "CompoundID") %>%
      full_join(ints, by = "CompoundID") %>%
      full_join(bzj, by = "CompoundID") %>%
      full_join(ezj, by = "CompoundID")

    delta_cols <- paste0("DeltaLog2_", SEASON_LEVELS)
    fdr_cols <- paste0("FDR_", SEASON_LEVELS)
    dm <- as.matrix(tmp[, delta_cols, drop = FALSE])
    fm <- as.matrix(tmp[, fdr_cols, drop = FALSE])

    pos <- apply(dm, 1, function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z > 0))
    neg <- apply(dm, 1, function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z < 0))
    same <- pos | neg
    minabs <- apply(abs(dm), 1, function(z) if (all(is.finite(z))) min(z) else NA_real_)
    allsig <- apply(fm, 1, function(z) all(is.finite(z)) && all(z < ALPHA_FDR))

    A <- !is.na(tmp$Overall_FDR) &
      tmp$Overall_FDR < ALPHA_FDR &
      same & !is.na(minabs) &
      minabs >= MIN_ABS_DELTA_LOG2_EACH_SEASON_FOR_STABLE

    if (STABLE_REQUIRE_EACH_SEASON_FDR) A <- A & allsig

    tmp %>%
      transmute(
        CompoundID,
        PseudocountRule = c_rule,
        Pseudocount = c_value,
        Overall_FDR,
        StageSeasonInteraction_FDR,
        BZ_Season_FDR,
        EZ_Season_FDR,
        A_StableFermentation = A,
        B_SeasonModulatedFermentation =
          !is.na(StageSeasonInteraction_FDR) & StageSeasonInteraction_FDR < ALPHA_FDR,
        C_InitialSeasonMarker =
          !is.na(BZ_Season_FDR) & BZ_Season_FDR < ALPHA_FDR,
        D_TerminalSeasonMarker =
          !is.na(EZ_Season_FDR) & EZ_Season_FDR < ALPHA_FDR
      )
  }

  sens_long <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(candidate_tbl)), function(i) {
    run_core_classification_for_c(
      candidate_tbl$Pseudocount[i],
      candidate_tbl$Rule[i]
    )
  }))

  if (SAVE_DETAILED_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY) {
    write.csv(
        sens_long,
        file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "14_pseudocount_sensitivity_core_classification_long.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
  }

  primary_rule <- candidate_tbl$Rule[
    which.min(abs(candidate_tbl$Pseudocount - LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT))
  ]

  ref <- sens_long %>%
    filter(PseudocountRule == primary_rule) %>%
    select(
      CompoundID,
      Ref_A = A_StableFermentation,
      Ref_B = B_SeasonModulatedFermentation,
      Ref_C = C_InitialSeasonMarker,
      Ref_D = D_TerminalSeasonMarker
    )

  safe_jaccard <- function(x, y) {
    u <- sum(x | y, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (u == 0) return(1)
    sum(x & y, na.rm = TRUE) / u
  }

  sensitivity_summary <- sens_long %>%
    left_join(ref, by = "CompoundID") %>%
    group_by(PseudocountRule, Pseudocount) %>%
    summarise(
      N_A = sum(A_StableFermentation, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_B = sum(B_SeasonModulatedFermentation, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_C = sum(C_InitialSeasonMarker, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_D = sum(D_TerminalSeasonMarker, na.rm = TRUE),
      Agreement_A = mean(A_StableFermentation == Ref_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      Agreement_B = mean(B_SeasonModulatedFermentation == Ref_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      Agreement_C = mean(C_InitialSeasonMarker == Ref_C, na.rm = TRUE),
      Agreement_D = mean(D_TerminalSeasonMarker == Ref_D, na.rm = TRUE),
      Agreement_all4 = mean(
        A_StableFermentation == Ref_A &
        B_SeasonModulatedFermentation == Ref_B &
        C_InitialSeasonMarker == Ref_C &
        D_TerminalSeasonMarker == Ref_D,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Jaccard_A = safe_jaccard(A_StableFermentation, Ref_A),
      Jaccard_B = safe_jaccard(B_SeasonModulatedFermentation, Ref_B),
      Jaccard_C = safe_jaccard(C_InitialSeasonMarker, Ref_C),
      Jaccard_D = safe_jaccard(D_TerminalSeasonMarker, Ref_D),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  write.csv(
    sensitivity_summary,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "12_pseudocount_sensitivity_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  compound_stability <- sens_long %>%
    group_by(CompoundID) %>%
    summarise(
      N_candidates = n(),
      A_calls = sum(A_StableFermentation, na.rm = TRUE),
      B_calls = sum(B_SeasonModulatedFermentation, na.rm = TRUE),
      C_calls = sum(C_InitialSeasonMarker, na.rm = TRUE),
      D_calls = sum(D_TerminalSeasonMarker, na.rm = TRUE),
      A_stable_across_candidates = n_distinct(A_StableFermentation) == 1,
      B_stable_across_candidates = n_distinct(B_SeasonModulatedFermentation) == 1,
      C_stable_across_candidates = n_distinct(C_InitialSeasonMarker) == 1,
      D_stable_across_candidates = n_distinct(D_TerminalSeasonMarker) == 1,
      All4_stable_across_candidates =
        A_stable_across_candidates &
        B_stable_across_candidates &
        C_stable_across_candidates &
        D_stable_across_candidates,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (SAVE_DETAILED_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY) {
    write.csv(
        compound_stability,
        file.path(DETAIL_DIR, "15_pseudocount_sensitivity_compound_stability.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
  }
}

############################
```

## 20. Method and threshold record
```{r s20-method-and-threshold-record}
############################

method_notes <- c(
  "FINAL Flavor compound-level Season/Stage analysis",
  "",
  paste0("Input: flavor compound values; nondetects as zero = ", NONDETECT_AS_ZERO),
  paste0("Transformation: log2(x + ", LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT, ")"),
  paste0("Pseudocount mode: ", PSEUDOCOUNT_MODE),
  paste0("Pseudocount selection rule: ", PSEUDOCOUNT_SELECTION_RULE),
  paste0("Positive Q05 = ", signif(q05_positive, 6), "; positive median = ", signif(median_positive, 6)),
  paste0("Assessment of +1: ", plus1_assessment),
  paste0("Pseudocount sensitivity analysis enabled = ", RUN_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY),
  "No SD scaling is applied for compound-level differential testing.",
  "Raw-scale BZ/EZ fold changes are calculated separately from the original values without adding any pseudocount.",
  "Therefore pseudocount choice affects log-scale statistical modelling but does not redefine the reported raw fold changes.",
  "Model: StageSeason cell means + Park + BrewingCycle, equivalent to testing Stage x Season while controlling Park and BrewingCycle.",

  "Inference: limma linear models with empirical Bayes moderation; BH FDR correction.",
  paste0("FDR threshold: ", ALPHA_FDR),
  paste0("Kruskal-Wallis sensitivity/QC enabled = ", RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY),
  paste0("KW multiple-testing adjustment = ", KW_ADJUST_METHOD),
  "KW uses the original values directly and tests Season separately within BZ and EZ.",
  "KW is a single-factor rank-based sensitivity analysis and does NOT control Park or BrewingCycle.",
  "Because log2(x+c) is monotonic, log transformation is unnecessary for the KW rank test; pseudocount is therefore not used in KW.",
  "KW does not determine A-D membership. Categories C/D and all formal season-marker calls are based on the adjusted limma model controlling Park + BrewingCycle.",
  "KW-only compounds should be interpreted cautiously because apparent Season differences may reflect Park/Cycle background or may not survive multiple-testing adjustment in the adjusted model.",
  "AdjustedModel-only compounds can occur when controlling Park/Cycle reduces background variation and reveals a consistent Season effect.",
  "KW/model disagreement is summarized in one discordant-compound table; formal C/D calls remain based on the adjusted-model BH-FDR.",
  paste0("Detection filter: keep if detection fraction >= ", MIN_DETECTION_FRACTION_ANY_STAGE_SEASON, " in at least one Stage x Season group."),
  "",
  "Category A Stable fermentation-associated:",
  "  overall average EZ-BZ FDR < threshold AND all four seasons have the same EZ-BZ direction",
  paste0("  AND minimum absolute DeltaLog2 across seasons >= ", MIN_ABS_DELTA_LOG2_EACH_SEASON_FOR_STABLE),
  paste0("  require all 4 season-specific contrasts individually FDR significant = ", STABLE_REQUIRE_EACH_SEASON_FDR),
  "",
  "Category B Season-modulated fermentation-associated:",
  "  Stage x Season omnibus FDR < threshold.",
  "",
  "Category C Initial seasonal marker:",
  "  BZ four-season omnibus FDR < threshold.",
  "",
  "Category D Terminal seasonal marker:",
  "  EZ four-season omnibus FDR < threshold.",
  "",
  "Final FermentationResponseType is mutually exclusive: I=A+B; II=A only; III=B only; IV=neither.",
  "C and D are retained as separate BZ and EZ seasonal-marker flags in MASTER for traceability.",
  "Type II: no detected Stage x Season interaction; this does not establish seasonal independence.",
  "Type III: significant interaction without meeting the complete A criterion; sign reversal is not required.",
  "BZ and EZ are independent samples within production contexts, not paired batches.",
  "BH correction is applied across compounds separately for each contrast or omnibus test."
)

writeLines(
  method_notes,
  con = file.path(OUTDIR, "13_README_analysis_definition.txt")
)

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(OUTDIR, "14_sessionInfo.txt")
)

############################
```

## 22. Final run summary
```{r s22-final-run-summary}
############################

message("\n==============================================")
message("Flavor compound Season/Stage analysis completed.")
message("data -> pseudocount QC -> log2(x+", LOG2_PSEUDOCOUNT, ") -> limma")

message("----------------------------------------------")
message("Number of compounds tested: ", nrow(master))
message("Type I  Stable direction + season-modulated:",
        sum(master$FermentationResponseType == "I_Stable_direction_but_season_modulated"))
message("Type II Consistent direction, no detected seasonal modulation:",
        sum(master$FermentationResponseType == "II_Stable_season_independent"))
message("Type III Seasonal modulation without meeting the full A criterion:",
        sum(master$FermentationResponseType == "III_Season_dependent_directionally_nonstable"))
message("Type IV Other:",
        sum(master$FermentationResponseType == "IV_Other"))
message("BZ initial seasonal markers count:",
        sum(master$C_InitialSeasonMarker))

message("EZ terminal seasonal markers count:",
        sum(master$D_TerminalSeasonMarker))

message("----------------------------------------------")
message("Master results: 05_MASTER_compound_results.csv")
message("Fermentation-response classification: 06_Fermentation_response_types_I_to_IV.csv")
message("Classification summary: 09_classification_summary.csv")
if (RUN_KW_SENSITIVITY) {
  message("KW sensitivity:10_KW_vs_adjusted_model_summary.csv + 11 discordant table")
}
if (RUN_PSEUDOCOUNT_SENSITIVITY) {
  message("Pseudocount sensitivity:12_pseudocount_sensitivity_summary.csv")
}
message("Output directory: ", normalizePath(OUTDIR, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
message("==============================================\n")

print(classification_summary)
```
